metadata.title: SOAR Evidence & Logging SSPP
metadata.remarks: This SSPP defines requirements ensuring that SOAR automation actions are fully observable, attributable, auditable, and forensically compatible. Automation activity is treated as first-class security evidence.

import-profile.remarks: This SSPP inherits all authority, response, forensic, and automation constraints and SHALL NOT redefine them.

system-characteristics.system-description: Defines evidentiary logging, attribution, integrity, and retention requirements for all SOAR automation actions.

system-implementation.remarks: All SOAR activity SHALL be treated as security-relevant telemetry. Absence or incompleteness of automation logs constitutes a control violation.

automation-evidence-scope.description: Invocation, execution path, and termination of automation playbooks.
Detection, confidence level, severity, and workflow context under which automation executed.
Specific actions taken, affected systems, identities, and artifacts.
Authorizing role, approval timestamp, and authorization scope.
Errors, aborts, suspensions, and boundary enforcement events.

evidence-requirements.statement: All automated actions SHALL be attributable to a specific approving human role.
Automation logs SHALL be protected against unauthorized modification or deletion.
Automation evidence SHALL correlate with detection, incident, and response records.
Automation evidence SHALL be retained for a duration sufficient to support forensic, legal, and governance needs.

forensic-compatibility.statement: When a forensic hold is declared, automation evidence SHALL be preserved and protected as evidentiary material.
Digital Forensics Authority SHALL have access to automation evidence without modification or transformation.

failure-handling.statement: Failure to generate or retain required automation evidence SHALL trigger a Violation & Drift Escalation.
Suspected tampering with automation logs SHALL escalate immediately to Digital Forensics.

control-implementation.description: Controls ensure automation activity is observable, auditable, and evidentiary.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Automation logs are reviewed and correlated with detection and response activity.
Automation evidence is protected from unauthorized modification or deletion.
Automation records are retained to support investigation and accountability.
Automation activity supports incident documentation and reporting.

statements.statement: SOAR automation SHALL NOT execute actions without generating corresponding evidentiary records.
Automation evidence SHALL be considered admissible forensic material once generated.
Lack of automation evidence SHALL invalidate trust in automated outcomes.
Automation observability SHALL NOT be reduced for operational convenience or performance.

back-matter.remarks: All SOAR engines, integrations, and playbook execution environments MUST enforce evidence generation and protection defined in this SSPP.
